```{r}
library(wooldridge)
data(mroz)
# a.
# 篩選參與勞動力市場的樣本
mroz_selected <- subset(mroz, inlf == 1)
# 建立新的Dummy variables
# 若 motheduc > 12 則為 1，否則為 0
mroz_selected$MOTHERCOLL <- ifelse(mroz_selected$motheduc > 12, 1, 0)
# 若 fatheduc > 12 則為 1，否則為 0
mroz_selected$FATHERCOLL <- ifelse(mroz_selected$fatheduc > 12, 1, 0)

# 計算受過部分大學教育的父母比例
mother_college_pct <- mean(mroz_selected$MOTHERCOLL, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
father_college_pct <- mean(mroz_selected$FATHERCOLL, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
cat("ANS of a.", "\n")
cat("參與勞動樣本數:", nrow(mroz_selected), "\n")
cat(sprintf("母親受過部分大學教育的百分比: %.2f%%\n", mother_college_pct))
cat(sprintf("父親受過部分大學教育的百分比: %.2f%%\n", father_college_pct))

# b.
vars_for_corr <- mroz_selected[, c("educ", "MOTHERCOLL", "FATHERCOLL")]
# 計算相關係數矩陣
cor_matrix <- cor(vars_for_corr, use = "complete.obs")
print(cor_matrix)
cat("ANS of b.", "\n")
cat("EDUC 和 MOTHERCOLL 的相關係數為 0.3595 ;EDUC 和 FATHERCOLL 的相關
係數為 0.3985。", "\n")
```
```{r}
# c.
library(ivreg)
wage_iv_model <- ivreg(log(wage) ~ educ + exper + I(exper^2) | MOTHERCOLL + exper + I(exper^2), data = mroz_selected)
summary(wage_iv_model)
# 計算 95% 信賴區間
educ_95percent_interval <- confint(wage_iv_model, level = 0.95)["educ", ]
cat("ANS of c.", "\n")
cat("The 95% interval estimate for the coefficient of EDUC is [", 
    round(educ_95percent_interval[1], 4), ", ", 
    round(educ_95percent_interval[2], 4), "]\n")
```

```{r}
# d.
# 估計第一階段方程式
first_stage_d <- lm(educ ~ exper + I(exper^2) + MOTHERCOLL, data = mroz_selected)
# 第一階段估計結果
summary(first_stage_d)

t_val <- summary(first_stage_d)$coefficients["MOTHERCOLL", "t value"]
f_stat <- t_val^2

cat("ANS of d.", "\n")
cat(sprintf("F-statistic: %.4f\n", f_stat))
cat("MOTHERCOLL 係數的 t 值是 7.973 , F-值是 63.5631 。 F 值遠大於常用的臨界值 10 ,
因此拒絕 MOTHERCOLL 對 EDUC 沒有影響的虛無假設 ,表示 MOTHERCOLL 是
一個強的工具變數。另外,Stock-Yogo 臨界值是一個用於檢測工具變數強度的標
準。如果願意接受10%的拒絕率來進行5%顯著性水平的檢定 ,則臨界值為16.38 。
MOTHERCOLL 的 F-統計量 63.21 遠大於 16.38 ,進一步證明它是強的工具變數。", "\n")
```

```{r}
# e.
library(ivreg)
wage_iv_model_ef <- ivreg(log(wage) ~ educ + exper + I(exper^2) | MOTHERCOLL + FATHERCOLL + exper + I(exper^2), data = mroz_selected)

summary(wage_iv_model_ef)

# 計算 95% CI
educ_95percent_interval_ef <- confint(wage_iv_model_ef, level = 0.95)["educ", ]
cat("ANS of e.", "\n")
cat("The 95% interval estimate for the coefficient of EDUC using both MOTHERCOLL and FATHERCOLL is [", 
    round(educ_95percent_interval_ef[1], 4), ", ", 
    round(educ_95percent_interval_ef[2], 4), "]\n")
```

```{r}
library(car)
# f.
# 估計第一階段方程式
first_stage_f <- lm(educ ~ exper + I(exper^2) + MOTHERCOLL + FATHERCOLL, data = mroz_selected)

# 檢定 MOTHERCOLL 與 FATHERCOLL 的聯合顯著性
f_test_result <- linearHypothesis(first_stage_f, c("MOTHERCOLL", "FATHERCOLL"))
print(f_test_result)
# 建立無工具變數的限制模型
restricted_model <- lm(educ ~ exper + I(exper^2), data = mroz_selected)
# 建立包含工具變數的全模型
full_model <- lm(educ ~ exper + I(exper^2) + MOTHERCOLL + FATHERCOLL, data = mroz_selected)
# F 檢定
anova_result <- anova(restricted_model, full_model)
print(anova_result)
cat("ANS of f.", "\n")
cat("MOTHERCOLL 和 FATHERCOLL 兩個工具變數的聯合顯著性 F-檢驗統計量為
56.963 > 10。值也超過了Stock-Yogo臨界值,該臨界值是根據樣本大小標準來確定的。如果願意接受 10% 的拒絕率來進行 5% 顯著性水平的檢定,臨界值為 19.93,拒絕工具變數是弱的虛無假設。", "\n")
```

```{r}
# g.
# 1. 資料集與模型建立
mroz_selected$MOTHERCOLL <- ifelse(mroz_selected$motheduc > 12, 1, 0)
mroz_selected$FATHERCOLL <- ifelse(mroz_selected$fatheduc > 12, 1, 0)
mroz_selected$mothercoll <- mroz_selected$MOTHERCOLL 
mroz_selected$fathercoll <- mroz_selected$FATHERCOLL

mroz_e_clean <- na.omit(mroz_selected)

first_stage_e <- lm(educ ~ exper + I(exper^2) + MOTHERCOLL + FATHERCOLL, data = mroz_e_clean)
mroz_e_clean$educ_hat_e <- predict(first_stage_e)

# 建立 iv_manual_e 模型
iv_manual_e <- lm(log(wage) ~ educ_hat_e + exper + I(exper^2), data = mroz_e_clean)

# 2. 執行 Sargan 檢定
mroz_e_clean$residuals <- residuals(iv_manual_e)
sargan_reg <- lm(residuals ~ exper + I(exper^2) + MOTHERCOLL + FATHERCOLL, data = mroz_e_clean)

r_squared <- summary(sargan_reg)$r.squared
n <- nrow(mroz_e_clean)
sargan_stat <- n * r_squared
df_sargan <- 2 - 1 
p_value_sargan <- 1 - pchisq(sargan_stat, df = df_sargan)

# 輸出結果
cat("ANS of g.", "\n")
cat(sprintf("Sargan Test Statistic (LM): %.4f\n", sargan_stat))
cat(sprintf("p-value: %.4f\n", p_value_sargan))
cat("虛無假設是工具變數有效。5%的臨界值為 0.6439＞0.2375，故無法拒絕虛無假設。", "\n")
```
